code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia (low oxygen saturation), mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and abnormal white cell differential (low neutrophils and lymphocytes, high basophils). There is also elevated creatinine, suggesting possible renal impairment, and mild hyperchloremia. Red cell indices are mostly normal except for increased RDW. These findings may indicate an underlying infection, possible bone marrow suppression, and impaired renal function; clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
